answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows. Consider a relic as the anchor of the cost. A wander stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a ridge...
